title: Aether Forge Planner Tool-Use Mapping
description: Pins the contract between an Aether Forge capability-manifest and the provider-native tool-use definitions emitted by `adapters.function_call.build_tool_schema_from_manifest`. v0.22.0+ (FP-1 deepening). Used by `PromptDrivenPlanner(tool_mode=True)` to opt out of JSON-string parsing entirely. Each declared capability becomes one tool. The OpenAI shape is canonical (used directly with `OpenAICompatiblePlanningModel.complete_with_tools`); `to_anthropic_tool_schema` adapts it to Anthropic's `input_schema` shape on the way out.

type.description: OpenAI tool-use shape. The Anthropic adapter rewraps this to `{name, description, input_schema}`.

description.description: Capability description shown to the model; sourced from `description` or `name` on the manifest entry.

parameters.description: JSON Schema for the tool's input. Sourced from `capabilities[].inputSchema` when present, otherwise an empty permissive object.
